task: EPMCDME-14582 — enable the 'Use OAuth 2.0 sign-in' toggle in SettingsForm when the credential type is locked (disableType) so the assistant-tools 'Create User Integration' popup no longer disables the auth-method choice on create.

technical_risk.label: XS
technical_risk.risk_factors: Governs an auth-method (OAuth vs PAT) selection in a popup, but the change is purely a presentational disabled-state flip with no authentication/authorization logic altered and no backend surface touched.
technical_risk.mitigation: Fully reversible one-token change; covered by a parametrized SettingsForm enabled-when-locked test (git/jira/confluence), an editing-disabled regression test, and a NewIntegrationPopup render test.

key_reasoning.reason: 3 files changed (SettingsForm.tsx plus two colocated test files, one new) — the only dimension above XS; production change is a single line while the bulk of the 124 insertions are tests.
One component touched — a single Switch's `disabled={editing || disableType}` narrowed to `disabled={editing}`; no layer boundaries crossed, credential-type select still respects disableType.
Presentational disabled-state flip, fully reversible, exact adjacent pattern exists; no auth/authorization logic, backend, or persistence involved.
